stories.title: Implement Base Feed Item Card Component
stories.goal: create a reusable feed item card component that displays all moment types consistently
stories.benefit: all feed content has uniform structure, spacing, and visual hierarchy
acceptanceCriteria: Card component includes header with user/author info, timestamp, and action menu
Card supports flexible content area for different moment types (text, images, structured data)
Card includes footer with engagement metrics (comments count, reactions count)
Card uses Shadcn UI Card component with consistent padding and borders
Card adapts to mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports with responsive design
Card includes hover and focus states for interactive elements

stories.title: Build Trade Moment Rendering Component
stories.goal: see trade moments displayed with clear team/player information and trade details
stories.benefit: I can quickly understand who was involved in the trade and what was exchanged
acceptanceCriteria: Trade moment shows team logos and names for both sides of trade
Trade moment displays players and picks exchanged in structured format
Trade moment includes timestamp showing when trade was processed
Trade moment links to transaction detail view when clicked
Trade moment uses icons or visual indicators to differentiate from other moment types
Trade moment supports multi-team trades with appropriate layout

stories.title: Create Match Result Moment Component
stories.goal: see weekly match results displayed with scores and team matchup information
stories.benefit: I can quickly review game outcomes without navigating to matchups page
acceptanceCriteria: Match result shows team names, logos, and final scores
Match result highlights winning team with visual emphasis
Match result includes week number and season context
Match result supports playoff game indicators and bracket context
Match result links to detailed matchup view when clicked
Match result displays properly for ties or unfinished games

stories.title: Design User-Generated Post Moment Component
stories.goal: see user posts displayed with author info, content, and optional media
stories.benefit: I can read league member commentary and engage with community content
acceptanceCriteria: Post moment displays author name, avatar, and role badge (Manager/Fan)
Post moment renders text content with proper line breaks and formatting
Post moment supports links with preview cards (future: media embeds)
Post moment includes edit/delete controls for post author
Post moment shows 'edited' indicator if content was modified
Post moment truncates long content with 'read more' expansion

stories.title: Build Power Rankings Moment Component
stories.goal: see power rankings published moments with condensed rankings preview
stories.benefit: I can see latest rankings directly in feed and access full rankings page
acceptanceCriteria: Rankings moment displays week number and season context
Rankings moment shows condensed preview of top 3-5 teams with ranks
Rankings moment includes commissioner commentary preview if available
Rankings moment links to full power rankings page when clicked
Rankings moment uses distinct visual styling to stand out in feed
Rankings moment shows timestamp of when rankings were published

stories.title: Create Matchup of the Week Moment Component
stories.goal: see featured matchup moments with hype text and commissioner predictions
stories.benefit: I can see which game to watch and the commissioner's prediction
acceptanceCriteria: Matchup moment displays both teams with logos and current records
Matchup moment shows commissioner's hype text and prediction
Matchup moment includes week number and featured matchup indicator
Matchup moment links to matchups page with featured game highlighted
Matchup moment updates to show actual result after game completes
Matchup moment shows prediction accuracy badge if graded

stories.title: Implement Comment Thread Component
stories.goal: read and post comments on feed items in a threaded conversation
stories.benefit: I can engage in discussions about moments and see what others are saying
acceptanceCriteria: Comment thread displays below moment content with collapsible section
Comments show author name, avatar, role badge, and timestamp
Comment input field appears when user clicks 'Add comment' action
Comments display in chronological order with newest first or last
Comments support edit and delete actions for comment author
Comment thread shows count of total comments and loads incrementally if many

stories.title: Build Reaction Controls Component
stories.goal: react to feed moments with emoji reactions and see others' reactions
stories.benefit: I can quickly express sentiment without writing comments
acceptanceCriteria: Reaction bar displays common emoji options (thumbs up, laugh, fire, etc.)
Reactions show count for each emoji type used on moment
User can add or remove their reaction by clicking emoji
User's selected reactions are visually highlighted
Reaction picker expands to show full emoji palette on demand
Reactions update in real-time or near-real-time for other users

stories.title: Create Infinite Scroll Feed Loading
stories.goal: continuously scroll through feed content without pagination controls
stories.benefit: I can browse feed effortlessly and discover more content naturally
acceptanceCriteria: Feed automatically loads next batch of moments when user scrolls near bottom
Loading indicator appears while fetching additional moments
Feed maintains scroll position when new moments are loaded
Feed handles end of content gracefully with 'caught up' message
Feed loads initial batch quickly (10-20 moments) for fast page render
Feed supports pull-to-refresh on mobile devices to get latest content

stories.title: Build Feed Item Action Menu Component
stories.goal: access contextual actions for feed moments via dropdown menu
stories.benefit: I can pin content, report issues, or access moment-specific options
acceptanceCriteria: Action menu trigger appears in top-right corner of feed item cards
Action menu includes options: Share, Report, Pin (admin only), Hide, Delete (author only)
Action menu adapts options based on user role and moment ownership
Action menu uses Shadcn UI DropdownMenu component for consistency
Action menu closes after selection or when clicking outside
Action menu is accessible via keyboard navigation

stories.title: Design Feed Loading Skeleton States
stories.user: User Waiting for Feed to Load
stories.goal: see appropriate loading placeholders while feed content loads
stories.benefit: I understand the page is loading and anticipate content structure
acceptanceCriteria: Feed displays 5-10 skeleton cards during initial load
Skeleton cards match feed item card dimensions and structure
Skeleton uses animated shimmer effect for visual feedback
Skeleton prevents layout shift when real content replaces placeholders
Skeleton respects responsive design for different viewport sizes
Skeleton loading state is accessible with appropriate ARIA labels

stories.title: Implement Feed Empty State Component
stories.goal: see helpful message when feed has no content yet
stories.benefit: I understand why the feed is empty and what actions I can take
acceptanceCriteria: Empty state displays centered message explaining no moments exist yet
Empty state includes illustration or icon for visual interest
Empty state provides call-to-action to create first post or connect league
Empty state differentiates between 'no content yet' and 'caught up' scenarios
Empty state adapts messaging based on user role (admin vs member)
Empty state maintains consistent styling with application theme
